text_block_list.text:
On this day, I was walking to our destination
with Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Using one's legs really is a wonderful thing.
The scenery is lovely, and it's quite refresh――"
(Skreeeech)
A car came to a sudden, screeching halt just ahead.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I heard an unusual sound.
Let's go check it out.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Um, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Driver
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Ah, yeah...
Well... it kind of feels like the tires are slipping.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ……May I take a look at the car?

text_block_list.name: Driver
text_block_list.text: S-Sure, but... be careful, okay?
Hearing that, Ikuno Dictus squatted down and began examining the tire intently.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...When was your car's last inspection?

text_block_list.name: Driver
text_block_list.text: Ah... maybe last year, I think.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's most likely a slow puncture.
The rear tire has deteriorated and is losing air pressure.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"It is dangerous to continue like this.
Let us change the tires. Do you have a spare?"

text_block_list.name: Driver
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah... Behind you.
Afterward, Ikuno Dictus quickly removed the tire and replaced it with a spare. She handled it with remarkably practiced ease...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It should be fine for now. But since you don't have a spare, please go to a repair shop later to get it and the rest checked out.

text_block_list.name: Driver
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Umamusume big sis!
I'll go get it checked right away!

Her skill at changing tires earlier was impressive.
When I mention that to her—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Actually, my father is an auto mechanic.
Because of that, I have been helping out with repairs since I was little.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, I merely did what I could...
......Ah.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
...It just reminded me a little of my father.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. My father repairs cars at a small workshop.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
She was quiet, never letting her composure slip.
Especially when it came to work...

text_block_list.name: Young Ikuno
text_block_list.text:
The dent in the car is all fixed.
Daddy, you're amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Father
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "No matter the praise offered, his only response was 'Yeah.' It was impossible to know what he was thinking... I just assumed it was his artisan temperament."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Until I could fix a car myself today,
and be thanked just like my father was...

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text: "I can't believe it was fixed up so beautifully! I'm so glad I asked you! Thank you so much!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Father
text_block_list.text:
No. This is my job, after all.
I'm just glad you're happy with it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My father always looked so proud
whenever he handed over a car.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
What truly mattered to Father was not praise for his technique,
but the gratitude of his customers.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I never thought I would be able
to learn about my father in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Going for a walk once in a while is a good idea after all.
choice_data_list: It's a good opportunity, so why not give them a call?
I bet he's a great dad.
I bet he's a great dad, huh?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Going for a walk once in a while is a good idea after all.
choice_data_list: It's a good opportunity, so why not give them a call?
I bet he's a great dad.
I bet he's a great dad, huh?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Indeed. It's a great opportunity, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, Dad? Actually, I just came across a car that broke down—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... I'm fine.
Said it... Understood. See you."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
? The phone call was longer than usual, you know?
And Father sounded happy too.

Though it feels a bit brief, Ikuno Dictus looks satisfied.
It is probably best not to nitpick.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. I already thought she was cool with her artisan-like spirit, but...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: He became a father to be proud of all over again.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I think I'll try talking to my father more.
About work and things like that.

They managed to deepen their family bond
in an unexpected way.
May they continue to get along well from now on.
